facts.fact: 烂笑话常被叫作“老爸笑话”，作者认为这对父亲有点不公平
facts.anchor: Rubbish jokes are often referred to as ‘dad jokes’, which seems slightly unfair on fathers.

facts.fact: “dad” 作为“糟糕”的同义词也扩散到服装、健身、音乐：老爹牛仔裤、老爹身材、老爹摇滚
facts.anchor: with dad jeans, dad bods and dad rock all failing to impress anyone

facts.fact: 过去直接叫“笑话”的那种可复述的小段喜剧，现在需要一个专属名字
facts.anchor: Now, the bite-sized bit of repeatable comedy that used to just be called a ‘joke’ needs its own name.

facts.fact: 过去的父亲下班回家，跟孩子正式握手、道晚安，然后喝一码威士忌放松
facts.anchor: Dads of the past came home from work, gave their children a formal handshake, bade them goodnight and relaxed with a yard of whisky.

facts.fact: 一口气抛出一串俏皮话，对建立关系有巨大价值
facts.anchor: there’s massive relationship-building value in reeling off some zingers

facts.fact: 如今父亲参与度高得多，但“爸，我饿了”／“你好饿了，我是爸”仍然存在
facts.anchor: ‘Dad, I’m hungry!’ / ‘Hi Hungry, I’m Dad!’ remains.

facts.fact: 二十世纪后半媒体普及＋女性大量进入职场，带来新刻板印象：笨手笨脚的情景喜剧爸爸
若要用一个家长称呼来暗示“糟糕、脱节”，叫“老爸”比叫“老妈”合理得多
facts.anchor: If assigning a parental name to something to suggest an element of rubbish out-of-touch-ness, ‘dad’ makes a lot more sense than ‘mum’.

facts.fact: 老爸看见蘑菇就讲“吃太多没有蘑菇（空间）了”，被嘘还坚持自己是“有趣的家伙”（fun guy／fungi）
facts.anchor: they don’t have mushroom for anything else, then responding to groans by insisting they’re a fun guy

facts.fact: 全章最后一句只留下“大问题是：”，包袱在插图里（Can you tell dad jokes if you aren’t a father, or is that a faux pa?）
